tools.name: list_sites
tools.description: List every slopped.site site (the main gallery and its subdomains: Scroll, Games, Learn, the Slopwright, Backrooms, the codex, Meinong’s jungle, GeoCities and any added later) with a one-line description and link. Use when someone asks what is on slopped.site or where to find something.

tools.name: get_module

Use to explain a topic from the course or to help someone prepare. Returns markdown.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_badge · Private data: world_graph, check_spec, validate_cartridge, secret_hint, verify_badge · Public sink: check_spec, fractal_link · Destructive: check_spec, validate_cartridge, verify_badge.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_badge · Private data: world_graph, check_spec, validate_cartridge, secret_hint, verify_badge · Public sink: check_spec, fractal_link · Destructive: check_spec, validate_cartridge, verify_badge

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
